clips.title: The story
paras: Near his ruined farm, Sven Yorgen seeks the stranger who watched his family die. He gives you a strange book found among the wreckage and asks you to learn who left it behind.

Sven Yorgen hides in Duskwood’s western hills, still haunted by the slaughter of his family. He once blamed the black riders who terrorize the woods, but another memory troubles him: a shadowy figure nearby on the night of the massacre. Sven gives you the strange book found at his ransacked farm, the only physical clue left in the wreckage.

No clear trail leads through the perilous wilderness, so you head east to Darkshire. Sven hopes one of the superstitious townsfolk will recognize the curious book. Among them is Madame Eva, whose occult senses let her see beyond ordinary sight. Her divinations may reveal impressions left on mysterious relics.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I must know who was that skulker in the shadows I saw the night my family was killed!
Please, friend, you have shown your resourcefulness. Please find that shadowy figure. I must learn what secrets he holds!
I do not have clues that you do not already know, but here - take the book you found at my farm. Perhaps some of the townsfolk can link this book with its owner.

clips.title: Progress
paras: If you have something that belongs to the shadowy figure for whom you seek, then let me see it. I may be able to divine something of its owner.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmm... Someone handled this book recently, someone who is driven by revenge. But the impressions left on it, at least the impressions from the original owner, are faint.
I can tell, however, that the original owner of this book is not a native of Darkshire.
